whatIsSection.title: What Is an E-commerce License in Dubai?
paragraphs: A business license for e-commerce is a legal license issued by Dubai's Department of Economic Development (DED), or applicable Free Zone authorities, that allows you to set up and run a business online.

It allows businesses to advertise, sell, and deliver products or services online, via mobile apps, or marketplaces. The E-Commerce License permits you to trade locally throughout the UAE or globally, depending on your jurisdiction.
Best Free Zone options for e-commerce licenses include IFZA, Shams, Dubai CommerCity, and RAKEZ — offering low-cost startup, 100% foreign ownership, and minimal restrictions.

sidebarCard.title: Still Have Questions?
sidebarCard.text: Get a free consultation with our e-commerce specialists.
sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about E-commerce License in Dubai.

items.q: Can I run my e-commerce business from outside of Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Many Free Zones allow you to operate remotely. If you are a UAE resident and want a bank account, you may need to visit Dubai on a temporary basis for KYC.

items.q: Is a warehouse needed for the e-commerce license?
items.a: No. Most e-commerce licenses only require a flexi-desk or shared workspace. Warehouses are optional and can be added later if you need physical storage.

items.q: Can I sell products and services using the same license?
items.a: Yes. An e-commerce license covers both physical products and digital services — including online trading, web portals, and downloadable products.

items.q: What payment gateways can I use?
items.a: You can integrate with Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, Network International, and other regional and international processors. We assist with setup and integration.

items.q: Do I need a banking account in the UAE?
items.a: It is highly recommended. A UAE corporate bank account allows you to accept local payments, integrate with payment gateways, and manage finances efficiently.

items.q: Can I employ staff with this licence?
items.a: Yes. An e-commerce license allows you to sponsor employment visas for staff and dependent visas for family members, based on your visa quota.

items.q: Will I get a visa with this licence?
items.a: Yes. You can apply for an investor visa (as the owner) and employee visas for your team. We handle the entire visa process including medicals and Emirates ID.

items.q: Is my business taxed in Dubai?
items.a: E-commerce businesses in eligible Free Zones enjoy 0% personal income tax and 0% corporate tax. We provide full tax advisory and VAT registration guidance.

items.q: How long does it take to obtain the licence?
items.a: Typically 1-5 working days depending on your jurisdiction and how quickly documents are provided. We fast-track the entire process.

items.q: Can I upgrade or expand the licence at a later date?
items.a: Yes. You can add new activities, upgrade your office space, increase visa quota, or expand to multiple jurisdictions as your business grows.
